description: Defines the EmailAddressRelationship class, a table-based many-to-many relationship handler extending M2MRelationship, with methods for adding and removing email address relationships in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: EmailAddressRelationship
classes.description: A class representing a many-to-many relationship for email addresses, extending M2MRelationship, with custom add and remove methods.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship between two beans, handling the link from the left side only, and manages relationship table entries.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the relationship between two beans, with checks for bean types and relationship loading.

methods.name: getRoleWhere
methods.description: Overrides parent method to add additional role filtering based on relationship role column and value.
